You'll work closely with Partner leadership and the broader RevOps team, with the autonomy to drive initiatives end-to-end and the visibility that comes with being a first dedicated hire in this space. You'll join a supportive, remote-first team that values autonomy, experimentation, and continuous learning, inside one of Europe's fastest-growing startups. Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on? US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are. Comfort moving between writing code, diagnosing a network issue, and working directly with hardware. Experience operating production Mac fleets, building macOS management agents, or designing infrastructure with limited off-the-shelf support is especially valuable.
